parts:
Dear all,

we would welcome a couple more people for our IPM workshop in St-Andrews in June 2018, just before the ISEC in St-Andrews. For information please see here: http://www.phidot.org/forum/viewtopic.php?f=8&t=3471&sid=3b305bd569c84117abddda1030513e31 . If you're interested don't hesitate to sign up even though the official deadline ends today I believe.

Best regards  ---- Marc, Michael and Chris
